traits.name: Positive Energy Affinity
traits.text: Positive healing effects always heal the jyoti for the maximum amount. It doesn't gain the automatic Hit Points or temporary Hit Points from being on a plane with the positive planar essence.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: (evocation, fire, occult); The jyoti breathes a blast of searing flame infused with positive energy in a 40-foot cone that deals 8d6 (8d6) fire damage plus 4d6 (4d6) positive damage to creatures in the area (DC 28 basic Reflex save) The jyoti can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Infuse Weapons
traits.text: (occult, evocation); Any weapon a jyoti wields becomes a flaming ghost touch weapon while the jyoti holds it.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ flaming ghost touch longspear +20 (magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 2d8+6 (2d8+6) piercing plus 1d6 (1d6) fire

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ talon +21 (agile, finesse); Damage 2d8+6 (2d8+6) slashing plus 1d6 (1d6) fire
